name: @matsiwolffie/dsh-backup
description: Backup and restore points for the DSH desktop app: profile configuration, sessions, local storage, and attachments are copied into a workspace folder together with an offline restore program.
author: MatsiWolffie

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/engine.js
scripts.test: node test/log.test.mjs && node test/diagnostics.test.mjs && node test/location.test.mjs && node test/point-id.test.mjs && node test/engine.test.mjs && node test/tool.test.mjs
